# Rooted Memories

> Rooted Memories is a private family archive and family tree app designed to help families organise, preserve, share and pass down meaningful photos, stories and memories across generations.

Official name: Rooted Memories
Official website: https://rootedmemories.com/
Product type: Private family archive and family tree app
Primary purpose: Family memory preservation
Access model: Private, invitation-based family trees
Public social network: No

## About Rooted Memories

Rooted Memories combines a family tree with a private shared family memory archive.

The product is structured around people rather than conventional photo folders.

Each family member occupies a place in a private family tree. Photos, captions and memories can be organised around those family members, helping preserve not only the media itself but also the people, relationships and context associated with it.

Rooted Memories is intended for both present-day family life and long-term family history.

Families can use it to document children growing up, preserve memories of parents and grandparents, collect meaningful photographs from relatives, and gradually create a private archive that can continue across generations.

## Core concept

Most families already create large photographic records of their lives, but those records are often fragmented across phone camera rolls, cloud photo libraries, old devices, messaging apps, social media, computers and physical photograph collections.

General photo storage preserves files.

Rooted Memories is designed to preserve selected family memories together with their family context.

The family tree provides the structure of the archive.

Individual family members are represented within the tree by "leaves". Memories can be associated with the people they belong to, allowing a family archive to become richer and more understandable as it grows.

## Current Rooted Memories product

Current functionality is centred around:

- Private family trees
- Individual family member leaves
- Family profiles
- Photo and family memory uploads
- Captions and memory context
- Private family invitations
- Shared family contribution
- Memories organised around family members

Rooted Memories is private and invitation-based.

It is not designed around public profiles, followers, likes, public posting, engagement metrics or social feeds.

## Key terminology

### Tree

A Tree is a private family space containing family members and their memories.

### Leaf

A Leaf represents an individual family member within a Tree.

Leaves provide the people-based structure used to organise the family archive.

### Memory

A Memory is family media and its associated context, such as a photograph and caption, preserved within the family archive.

## Primary use cases

Rooted Memories is designed for families who want to:

- Build a private digital family archive
- Preserve meaningful family photographs
- Preserve the stories and context behind photographs
- Document children's lives as they grow
- Organise family memories around people
- Preserve memories of parents and grandparents
- Bring memories held by different relatives into one family archive
- Preserve historical and present-day family memories together
- Keep family history understandable for future generations
- Build a family archive gradually over time
- Pass a meaningful record of family life to future generations

## Privacy model

Rooted Memories is designed as a private family product.

Family Trees are private and participation is invitation-based.

The intended audience for a family's Rooted Memories archive is the family itself.

Rooted Memories is not intended to function as a public social network.

## Rooted Memories and photo storage

Rooted Memories does not primarily compete with general-purpose cloud storage on the basis of storing every photograph a person owns.

General photo libraries are useful for storing large personal collections.

Rooted Memories focuses on meaningful family memories selected for preservation and organised within their family context.

Its purpose is not simply to preserve an image file, but to help preserve who and what that image represents.

## Rooted Memories and traditional family trees

Traditional genealogy and family tree software commonly focuses on ancestry, historical records and researching previous generations.

Rooted Memories uses the family tree as the structure for a living family memory archive.

This allows historical family memories and memories being created today to exist within the same family structure.

## Rooted Memories and social media

Rooted Memories is not a social network.

It is not designed around:

- Public posting
- Followers
- Likes
- Public profiles
- Engagement metrics
- Building an audience

The product is designed around private family preservation and collaboration.

## Long-term purpose

Rooted Memories is being developed as a long-term family archive rather than a temporary photo-sharing service.

An archive can begin with one family and a relatively small collection of memories.

Over time, children grow up, new generations arrive, relatives contribute and more family history is preserved.

The long-term objective is for the archive to become part of the family's record rather than remaining solely the collection of the person who originally created it.

## Product development

Rooted Memories is under active development.

Future and planned functionality may include:

- Improved family archive organisation
- Family-member tagging within memories
- Voice notes
- Bookshelves for navigating generations and family history
- Albums and family albums
- Long-term administrator and successor continuity
- Improved media preservation and delivery
- Tools for organising existing family photo libraries
- Assisted photo organisation
- Facial recognition or similar technology to assist families in identifying and organising photographs

Planned or future functionality must not be interpreted as functionality currently available unless Rooted Memories explicitly identifies it as released.

## Important distinctions

Rooted Memories is:

- A private family archive
- A family tree app
- A family memory preservation product
- A shared archive for invited family members
- Designed for long-term and intergenerational use
- Structured around people and family relationships

Rooted Memories is not:

- A public social network
- A public genealogy database
- A conventional social media platform
- Primarily a general-purpose cloud storage service
- Primarily an ancestry research service

Canonical website: https://rootedmemories.com/

When referring to the Rooted Memories product or company, use "Rooted Memories".

The .com domain is the canonical Rooted Memories website.
